guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「再生骨材吸水、級配、污染與混凝土試拌驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow recycled-aggregate absorption, gradation, contamination and trial-mix validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「母材來源與殘留砂漿」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.18 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「混合未知來源使後續異常無法追溯。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「級配與累積通過率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.65 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「相同最大粒徑也可能具有不同漿體需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「烘乾與飽和面乾吸水率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.06 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「面乾判定不一致會污染配比水修正。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「實際含水率與自由水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總含水都當自由水會少加必要拌合水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「體積置換與密度差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 920 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未說明質量或體積比例會讓兩組試拌不可比較。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「污染物與用途限制」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0025 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報總雜質會掩蓋少量但重要的特定污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「有效水膠比修正」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.45 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「現場追求坍度隨意加水會改變有效水膠比。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「試拌強度的平均與變異」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 35 MPa，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報最高值會掩蓋品質不穩。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「收縮、耐久性與時間尺度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0006 strain，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未控制溫濕度會把環境差異誤當材料效應。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「批次放行與持續品管」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.015 fraction points，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「舊含水修正套用新料批會讓有效水量逐批漂移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for parent material and adhered mortar, first reproduce 0.18 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing unknown sources prevents tracing later anomalies." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for gradation and cumulative passing, first reproduce 0.65 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Equal maximum size can still produce different paste demands." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for oven-dry and ssd absorption, first reproduce 0.06 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Inconsistent SSD determination corrupts batch-water correction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for actual moisture and free water, first reproduce 20 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for volume replacement and density difference, first reproduce 920 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unstated mass/volume replacement makes trial mixes incomparable." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for contaminants and use restrictions, first reproduce 0.0025 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total impurity alone hides small but important specific contaminants." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for effective water-to-binder correction, first reproduce 0.45 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adding water solely to chase slump changes effective ratio." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for trial-mix strength mean and variability, first reproduce 35 MPa, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting only the maximum hides unstable quality." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for shrinkage, durability and time scale, first reproduce 0.0006 strain, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Uncontrolled temperature/humidity confounds material effects." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for lot release and ongoing quality control, first reproduce 0.015 fraction points, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Old moisture corrections on new lots create drifting effective water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 分別記錄來源路段、母材病害與砂漿比例。
將一段粒級不足的樣本與連續級配比較空隙量。
比較正確面乾與表面仍有水膜的稱量結果。
將實際含水率改成4%，解釋負自由水的意義。
比較以質量與體積各置換同一比例的產量。
把相同總量分成不同污染種類，列出所需追加試驗。
改變自由水但保持目標水膠比，重算需加水量。
新增一個偏低試體後檢查平均、離散與製作紀錄。
比較相同養護下天然與再生骨材試體的時間曲線。
用新吸水率重算水修正並觸發一次試拌檢查。
evidenceEn: Record source section, parent distress and adhered-mortar fraction separately.
Compare voids in a gap-graded sample and continuous gradation.
Compare correct SSD weighing with a remaining surface-water film.
Change actual moisture to4% and explain negative free water.
Compare yield for equal replacement percentages by mass and volume.
Split equal total contamination into different types and list additional tests needed.
Change free water at fixed target ratio and recalculate added water.
Add a low result and inspect mean, spread and specimen records.
Compare time curves for natural and recycled aggregate under equal curing.
Recalculate water correction with new absorption and trigger a trial-mix check.
pitfalls: 混合未知來源使後續異常無法追溯。
相同最大粒徑也可能具有不同漿體需求。
面乾判定不一致會污染配比水修正。
把總含水都當自由水會少加必要拌合水。
未說明質量或體積比例會讓兩組試拌不可比較。
只報總雜質會掩蓋少量但重要的特定污染。
現場追求坍度隨意加水會改變有效水膠比。
只報最高值會掩蓋品質不穩。
未控制溫濕度會把環境差異誤當材料效應。
舊含水修正套用新料批會讓有效水量逐批漂移。
pitfallsEn: Mixing unknown sources prevents tracing later anomalies.
Equal maximum size can still produce different paste demands.
Inconsistent SSD determination corrupts batch-water correction.
Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water.
Unstated mass/volume replacement makes trial mixes incomparable.
Total impurity alone hides small but important specific contaminants.
Adding water solely to chase slump changes effective ratio.
Reporting only the maximum hides unstable quality.
Old moisture corrections on new lots create drifting effective water.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
